subject: general
question: According to World Steel Association, which of the following countries was the global leader in steel production for the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Steel Association, 2020**

 
 
• The** worldwide trade organisation for the iron and steel sector is known as the World Steel Association or worldsteel**.
 
• With participants from every significant nation that **produces steel,** the group is among the **biggest and most active in its field**. 
 
• The amount of crude steel produced globally in **2020 was 1877.5 million tonnes** (Mt), up 0.2% from the year before.
 
• China now produces the most steel, with **57 percent of global steel output in 2020**.
 
• China produced more than a** billion tonnes** of steel for the first time in 2020.
 
• In that year, **China Baowu Group produced over 115 million metric tonnes** of basic steel.
 
• China was only the** fourth-largest steel manufacturer in the world in 1990**, after Japan, the US, and the USSR.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Steel Association **is a nonprofit organisation with its **main office in Brussels, Belgium, and a second headquater in Beijing, China**.
 
• One of the most useful and necessary materials in the world is** steel, a metal that is an alloy of 97.9–99.98% iron and 2.1–0.002% carbon**.
 
• The manufacturing of steel is one of the **most energy- and carbon-intensive businesses in the world**, as per the U.S. Energy Information Administration.
 
• Around **7% of the world's carbon dioxide emissions in 2020** came from the manufacture of steel.
